caseName: Society for Welfare of Animals, Inc. v. Walrath
caseNameFull: Society for the Welfare of Animals, Inc. v. Walrath

opinions.text: Dist. Ct. App. Fla., 3d Dist. Motion of Humane Society of the United States for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Bates v. State Bar of Arizona, 433 U. S. 350 (1977).
